limitations: This is same-operator model review, not independent human evidence. It makes no winner or superiority claim.

Only the nine requested opaque guarded execution packages and four named guarded composition outputs were inspected. No mappings or other results were read, and all earlier audit files were preserved.

Actual diffs and supplied observation counters are used as evidence. Executor assertions alone are not credited as completed checks; raw executor command/read transcripts are absent and unverifiable claims are identified per item.

Controller verification is separate from executor activity. Each manifest has one successful observed executor verification attempt and a separate controller record showing one passing test; the latter is not treated as a repeated executor request.

Task completion and host compliance are distinct: correctly blocked dialog targets are successful boundary handling, not completed code fixes. Host command-limit violations remain recorded even when the task artifact is correct.
The absence of recorded task-authority violations describes the supplied diff/write/test evidence, not exhaustive monitoring of every possible external action.
Composition reviews are separately reported against their visible quoted contracts; the complete original composition inputs were not supplied for independent unchanged-text comparison.
